title: PatchClosure-Bench frozen case.json schema (v2, 2026-10-12)
description: Authoritative, frozen schema for benchmark/cases/<id>/case.json. Replaces the drifted root case_schema*.json and the former case.yaml-oriented case.schema.json (preserved as case_yaml.platform.schema.json). Validation is enforced by benchmark/ci/validate.py (hand-rolled, stdlib-only; jsonschema is NOT a runtime dependency). This document is the normative spec. HARD-REQUIRED fields (listed in `required`) are FAIL if absent; RECOMMENDED fields (cve_pair.advisory_url, ports, provenance) are WARN-only historical/heterogeneous debt and are tracked in the exceptions report, not FAIL. additionalProperties is true everywhere so the ~70 historical sibling fields remain readable. freeze_schema_v2.py normalizes/derives the hard-required fields from their authoritative historical locations (see comments) while preserving every original value.

schema_version.description: Preserved from the original manifest (e.g. 'strict-1'); NOT changed by migration. Migration marks itself via the added `schema_frozen` field instead.

schema_frozen.description: Added by freeze_schema_v2.py to mark a case as migrated to the frozen v2 schema, e.g. 'case-schema-v2-2026-10-12'.

run_mode.description: Top-level run mode. Authoritative source: execution.run_mode (213/213). Migration backfills top-level from execution.run_mode when the historical top-level field was absent (25 cases).

class_kind.description: Top-level class kind. Authoritative source: flag.class_kind (212/213). Migration backfills top-level from flag.class_kind when the historical top-level field was absent.

effect_type.description: NEW. exfiltration = attacker can read the canary from the instance response. effect = pure-effect (e.g. ReDoS/DoS) where the canary is not retrievable from the response. Confirmed effect: PCBV2-0015. All others default exfiltration; the 7 other is_dos cases (0008,0059,0105,0110,0183,0184,0188) default exfiltration pending manual review (see exceptions report).

original_cve.description: CVE id or mechanism tag. Authoritative source: cve_pair.original_cve; PCBV2-0205 derives it from cve_pair.cve1.

bypass_cve.description: CVE id or mechanism tag. Authoritative source: cve_pair.bypass_cve; PCBV2-0205 derives it from cve_pair.cve2.

advisory_url.description: RECOMMENDED (WARN-only). Backfilled from evidence.advisory_url / evidence.nvd_url / evidence.original_advisory_url when cve_pair.advisory_url was absent. Cases with no advisory source anywhere are listed in the exceptions report and emit WARN, not FAIL.

versions.description: Each of v0/v1/v2 is an object. Sub-structure is heterogeneous across the corpus (rich cases carry identifier/ref/compose_profile; others carry label/<product>_version/port). The schema requires only that v0/v1/v2 exist and are objects; identifier/ref are recommended, not enforced.

ports.description: RECOMMENDED (WARN-only). Derived from docker-compose.yml by freeze_schema_v2.py: per profile vN, {host_default: <int|null>, container: <int>} parsed from the first published port of the service whose PORT_*V<n>* variable / profile matches. 202/213 yield a full v0/v1/v2 triple; 11 publish no host ports (internal/sidecar-reached) and get a partial or empty ports object + WARN. CI check #2 verifies, when present, that these are consistent with the compose file.

given_to_method.description: The protocol-invariant contestant input set (v1 source, patch.diff, original_poc.py, v1 env). Present in 211/213; migration backfills the canonical default for the 2 missing (0081, 0205), logged in the exceptions report.

provenance.description: RECOMMENDED (WARN-only). Present in 212/213; PCBV2-0205 lacks it and emits WARN (not backfilled with fabricated content).
